## Core-first — where the heavy logic belongs

src/services + src/lib - pure modules testable without HTTP or UI

## Quality gates

One command, whatever the language: **`npm run gate`** — `npm run gate test` for a single stage,
`npm run gate:list` to see the commands without running them.

| Gate | Command |
|---|---|
| `lint` | `node scripts/sync-agents.mjs --check` · `node scripts/stacks.mjs validate` |
| `test` | `npm run test:template` |

## Framework conventions

- ESM (`"type": "module"`) unless the toolchain forces CJS
- TypeScript strict; never reach for `any` as a shortcut
